description: Independent local OpenClaw backend with the selected 1.0-derived incremental frontend and explicitly requested WorkBuddy mechanisms.

features.description: Independent source, application identity, configuration, credentials and data; the previous version remains runnable.
steps: Record the baseline without changing production.
Create independent paths and enforce isolation.
Verify both versions can coexist.
features.verification: Isolation tests and a real independent service launch; previous checkout and service unchanged.

features.description: Freeze the complete existing and WorkBuddy experience matrix without silent exclusions.
steps: Inventory reviewed mechanisms and existing workflows.
Associate every requirement with implementation and acceptance evidence.
features.verification: Reopened: the prior matrix omitted existing avatar/section/pinning behavior and treated speculative Creative/Expert workflows as user requirements. Reconcile the selected incremental frontend with the retained backend before accepting inheritance.

features.description: Run OpenClaw as the sole supervised kernel with official event and control contracts.
steps: Supervise the pinned real Node Gateway.
Use official SDK exports.
Persist and push execution facts without normal state polling.
features.verification: Official runtime integration: tool, assistant, lifecycle, final and provider error events.

features.description: Durable submission, queue, final writes and graceful-restart continuation.
steps: Keep stable submission identities.
Associate resumed engine runs with their original task.
Verify ordered queued input and complete resumed answers.
features.verification: Lost acknowledgment, duplicate input, reconnect delta/reset, graceful restart and hard crash integrations.

features.description: Approvals, questions, steering and continuation retain exact execution ownership.
steps: Expose supported approval and question events.
Resolve against the original execution.
Verify steering and independent sessions.
features.verification: Approve, deny, answer, disconnect and resume scenarios with no unrelated task blocking.

features.description: Stop turns, ordinary commands, independent services and delegated work with confirmed cleanup.
steps: Separate cancellation receipts from termination.
Use official process instance controls.
Handle partial cleanup without blocking unrelated work.
features.verification: Actual child process exit, scoped cancellation, timeout and cleanup-failure tests.

features.description: Persistent conversations, attachments, streaming and ordered text/reasoning/tool presentation.
steps: Preserve ordered execution blocks.
Show full-width document replies.
Recover the same rendering after service or client restart.
features.verification: Native conversation integration keeps one ordered document (tool results, no invented final) across SIGKILL, product reopen and explicit continuation; an existing real-kernel browser fixture replays two reasoning stages, commentary, a tool step and a final outside the process, persisting across reload; synthetic projection renders an interrupted document; wide/light and 390px/dark reviewed without overflow; same-millisecond input/reply order fixed.

features.description: Long tasks, progress, task handoff, delivery receipts and notifications.
steps: Persist task ownership and reporting destinations.
Retain background work and actionable states.
Associate real files and completion notifications.
features.verification: Native conversation integration holds one Bot's turn while a second Bot in its own conversation completes and delivers an exact file, with one result notice bound to that reply; scheduled result delivery, work records and notification navigation were accepted earlier. OS-level popups remain separately unverified.

features.description: Consistent private, project, task, inbox, archive and explicit shared workspace rules.
steps: Create predictable per-Bot directories.
Enforce authorized roots and safe paths.
Track artifact origin and prevent destructive overwrite.
features.verification: Traversal, symlink, filename collision and cross-Bot scope tests plus real file delivery.

features.description: Markdown tables, inline visualization, code, HTML/SVG preview and export.
steps: Render native document content.
Sandbox active previews.
Provide file, code and table actions.
features.verification: Browser acceptance covers table copy/export with exact bytes, sandboxed HTML/SVG preview from a code fence and file preview/export; deterministic tests pin code export names and media types, preview eligibility, escaping and CSV/TSV serializers; wide/light and 390px/dark reviewed.

features.description: Durable scheduled tasks and notifications with cancellation and catch-up semantics.
steps: Use official automation execution contracts.
Persist user-facing schedule and delivery.
Verify restart and cancellation behavior.
features.verification: A scheduled synthetic task produces one intended delivery across restart.

features.description: Native memory, same-agent private conversation recall, Chinese intent and provenance.
steps: Configure native memory and Active Memory.
Preserve stable agent identity and private metadata.
Verify Chinese recall and unrelated-agent exclusion.
features.verification: Real native memory integrations and opt-in rubric-based semantic acceptance.

features.description: Previewable, scoped memory forgetting with recoverable backup.
steps: Preview affected source lineage.
Require explicit apply with a verified backup.
Keep user files recoverable and disclose coverage.
features.verification: Preview is nonmutating; applied forgetting affects only selected memories and can be restored.

features.description: LivingBot-internal group conversations with persistent membership and per-Bot identity.
steps: Create groups and membership.
Associate Bot replies and tasks with their origin.
Retain private conversations independently.
features.verification: A group with multiple Bots completes an actual coordinated synthetic task.

features.description: Private/group contextual recall with source and audience boundaries.
steps: Retrieve relevant permitted messages and summaries.
Distinguish private reasoning access from public disclosure.
Retain evidence and explicit sharing.
features.verification: Official-kernel suite rerun on the current build: a native tool call from a private turn reads a permitted group, refuses another Bot's private conversation and unshared private records from a group, and reads only the selected shared private excerpt while refusing reads after revocation. Deterministic selector tests cover implicit disclosure.

features.description: Group task delegation and separate private reporting are understood and executed.
steps: Create structured task assignments.
Persist exact reporting destinations.
Deliver and reconcile child outcomes.
features.verification: Native scheduled coordinator run on the current build assigns two owned child tasks, one delivers an exact private file and one fails through a provider rejection; both outcomes retain their own private reports, notices and file, and survive full restart without reexecution.

features.description: One ordinary-language ability center for skills, services, connectors, tools and account authorization.
steps: Normalize the capability inventory.
Preview access and source.
Enable or disable per Bot and revoke authorization.
features.verification: Browser and service tests manage different ability types through the same product flow.

features.description: Bots can delegate work to Codex and WorkBuddy while OpenClaw remains the kernel.
steps: Verify each supported external protocol.
Implement progress, cancel and file delivery.
Expose delegated work as owned child tasks.
features.verification: Actual supported executor calls for both products, including stop and result delivery.

features.description: GitHub-backed Bot and ability packages with author submission, review, versioned installation and update/revocation.
steps: Define reviewed data-only packages.
Validate paths, permissions and provenance.
Pin installation to reviewed revisions.
Support export and submission without leaking personal memory.
features.verification: Install, update, reject executable/traversal packages and export a sanitized Bot; real GitHub read path.

features.description: Task/file routing, precise document revisions, bulk imports and partial failure recovery.
steps: Provide original task-method capabilities.
Preserve anchors, batches and per-item receipts.
Verify representative document and table workflows.
features.verification: Reviewed document edits and batch replay do not overwrite unrelated content or duplicate successful items.

features.description: Distinct shared visual system, new icon language, light/dark themes and accessible controls.
steps: Explore actionable design alternatives.
Use shared semantic tokens and existing component primitives.
Verify contrast, focus, motion and responsiveness.
features.verification: Rendered desktop/narrow screenshots and keyboard acceptance; user review of visual direction.

features.description: Clickable Bot panorama backed by real task states, with compact navigation.
steps: Map Bots and actionable waiting states.
Navigate directly to conversation.
Retain efficient compact navigation.
features.verification: Reopened: the tested replacement panorama is not the user-selected frontend. Verify the incremental panorama against the retained backend, including existing avatars, Bot sections and pinning.

features.description: Shared product contracts across desktop, browser and applicable native mobile workflows.
steps: Host web UI and local kernel in an independent desktop app.
Expose an authenticated shared API.
Implement or explicitly validate safe platform-specific degradation.
features.verification: Reopened: earlier desktop/browser evidence covers the rejected replacement frontend. Re-establish installed desktop and browser workflows using the selected incremental frontend.

steps: Audit dependency and build entry graphs.
Exclude unnecessary legacy products.
Retain the previous runnable release.
features.verification: Independent build/start works without cloud computer, VM or old bridge configuration.

steps: Build an independent installation.
Verify requirement-level completion evidence.
Trial all selected Bots and full experience matrix.
Leave default-version switching to the user.
features.verification: Actual installable artifact, full acceptance record, unchanged previous release and verified rollback.
